lines.text: Welcome to Venice Beach Court! Boardwalk on the mic, sand on the court, sun on the water, and the pier is watching!
Venice, say hello! It's Boardwalk, live from the loudest slab of concrete between the pier and Dogtown!
Drum circle, drop a beat! Skaters, roll on in! Tourists, phones up! Boardwalk has the mic, and Venice Beach Court is open!
What's good, beach people! Sun going down, lights coming up, tacos on the grill, and Boardwalk on the mic. Let's run it!
When I say Venice, you say Beach! Venice!
Pier side, where you at?! Taco stand side, you're louder! Prove me wrong!
Big love to the drum circle! Give me a beat, give me a beat!
Where my Dogtown skaters at? Tap those decks on the concrete!
Captain Sunscreen, front row since noon! That's dedication, Venice!
Sand side, surf side, taco side too! Venice, let me hear you!
Taco stand just sold twelve tacos to one person. Twelve! That's a whole team's lunch!
Sun's sinking into the ocean like a soft free throw. Venice, that's a make every night!
Twenty years on this mic, and the seagulls still think they run this court. They don't. I do.
Dogtown kids rolling by on the bike path, doing tricks nobody asked for. Respect! Venice never sits still.
Lifeguard tower says the water's perfect. Boardwalk says the court is hotter. Who you trusting?
Churro cart rolling by. Cinnamon in the air, sand on the court. That's the Venice combo meal!
Breeze coming off the ocean, so if your shot drifts left, blame the Pacific. That's the rule.
Court rule since forever: loser buys the lemonade. The lemonade stand loves a close game.
Tide is coming in! You feel that, Venice?
Ooh, the kid's finding a rhythm out here!
Warm sand, warmer shots! Keep it coming!
High tide, Venice! Everybody on your feet!
Sizzling sand! Somebody bring this hooper some water!
Phones up, tourists! You'll want this one!
Riptide! This beach can't handle it!
Boardwalk approved, stamped, and framed! Can't miss!
Ocean's boiling, Venice! Whole pier is up!
Somebody call the lifeguard, the sand's melting!
Low tide, kid. It always comes back.
Little sand in your shoes? Shake it out!
Building sandcastles with those bricks! Next one drops!
That's a wrap, Venice! Boardwalk approved! Take a bow, and take the sunset with you!
Write it in the sand, the tide can't wash this one away! You ran Venice!
Venice Beach, on your feet for the winner! Honorary local, starting right now!
Game, set, sunset! The kid came to the beach and took the whole boardwalk home!
Not today, but the tide always comes back in. Venice will be here. Run it back!
Big respect! You left it all on the sand. Grab a taco and come back hungry!
Venice, give it up anyway! That's a hooper who'll be back, and Boardwalk will be waiting!
Sand in your shoes means you're coming back. Rematch is on the house, my friend!
Wings on, Venice, it's Flight Night! Two rounds, two dunks each, five judges on the sand, and one rival with a plan!
It's Flight Night, Venice! Five judges, two rounds, two dunks apiece, and somebody across the court who wants your spot. Get loud!
The pier is packed for Flight Night! Two rounds, two dunks a round, five judges, one rival waiting. Who's ready?!
Back for more? Venice loves a regular! Flight Night, let's go again!
The kid came back! Same sand, new night, bigger dunks. I hope.
Another Flight Night at Venice! The tide keeps coming back, and so do you!
Look across the sand, Venice: tonight's rival! Wave hello, then pick a side!
Every Flight Night needs a rival, and this one flew in hungry. Give it up, Venice!
Clockwork Cass! Tick, tock, tomahawk! Same dunk, same time, never a miss, never a twist!
Heavy-duty Ty! Big power, few words, and a windmill that shakes the whole pier!
Pilot! Reads the room like a surf report, then takes the wave. Watch that three-sixty!
Zo the Show! Plays to the cameras, not the judges. Phones up for that eastbay!
No-brakes Stack! Tries the wild one first and laughs the whole way. Between the legs? Warm-up!
Boardwalk's clear, sand is swept. You're up!
Here comes the kid! Phones up, Venice!
Your turn! Show the pier something new!
Quiet on the sand... dunker's up.
Hold those tacos, Venice! Dunker coming through!
Shake the sand off! Same dunk, again!
Skaters fall, skaters get up! Go again!
One more time, Venice! Help the kid out!
Second try, same dream. Let's see it!
Last wave of the day. Ride it!
Final attempt! Venice, give the kid some noise!
Third try! Tide goes out after this one!
Here we go!
Send it!
Fly, kid, fly!
Go, go, go!
Let it rip!
Clean and simple, just how Venice likes it...
Nice and easy on the rim...
Solid! Tourists, that one's called...
Textbook, kid. Nothing fancy, all business...
That'll count! Tell them what it was...
Easy money on the sand...
Ooh, the judges are leaning forward!
Oh, that one came with extra sizzle!
Venice, say it with me...
Pier's nodding, judges nodding! That was...
Tide is coming in with that one!
Sweet as the churro cart!
Whoa, look at the lift on that...
Now we're talking, Venice!
Put it on a postcard!
Boardwalk approved! Frame it on the pier!
Whole beach just stood up!
Close the boardwalk! Everybody go home!
Drum circle, go double time!
Up, Venice! Up, up, up!
Somebody check on that rim!
No way! No way! Venice, you saw it!
Hand me a new mic, this one's melted!
Tourists screaming! Phones shaking! What was that?!
Fifty! Five judges, five tens, one perfect sunset!
Perfect fifty! Boardwalk approved, judge approved, ocean approved!
Tens across the board! Carve it into the pier!
Top marks! The judges ran out of numbers!
Old news on the boardwalk! Judges want something fresh!
Same wave twice? The judges want a new one!
Ooh, we saw that earlier! Points get washed out.
Leftovers from the taco stand! Tasty, but the judges noticed.
Wipeout! Paddle back out, kid!
Ooh, the sand wins that one!
Not this time! Venice still loves you!
Almost! Even the taco stand gasped!
Nope! Rim said come back later!
Sand in your shoes on that one!
In and out! The rim changed its mind!
Rattled, rolled, and rolled right out!
Clanked it! The iron won that round!
Lost the lob in the sunset!
Where'd it go? The ocean breeze took it!
Missed the catch! Ball's headed for the pier!
Clipped it! Obstacle's fine, dunk's not!
Snagged it on the way over! So close!
Hurdle got a vote, and it voted no!
That's all three, Venice. Clap it up for the effort!
Out of tries. Marked a miss. Next one's yours, kid!
Judges mark it a miss. Shake it off, next one!
Judges, what you got?
Cards up, panel!
Let's see those numbers!
Five judges... drum roll!
Rival's up! Hold those cheers, Venice... mostly!
Other side's up! Let's see what they brought!
Cass is up. Set your watch by it.
Here comes Ty. Big surf warning, Venice!
Pilot's up. Reading the room, reading the waves.
Zo's up! Tourists, you know what to do!
Stack's up! Lifeguard, stay close on this one!
Respect from the sand for that one...
Rival answered the call!
Even the skaters stopped rolling for that...
They came to play, Venice!
Tick, tock, Cass delivers on time...
Ty brought the heavy surf!
Pilot picked the perfect wave, then rode it...
Zo played it straight to the phones!
No brakes, no fear, and Stack landed it!
Off the rim! Venice exhales!
Rival wiped out! Door's open, kid!
Missed it! Drum circle, keep that beat going!
Nope! The rim is on our side!
Sand in their shoes! Your window, kid!
Round two! Final round! Sun's almost down, so make it count!
Last round on the sand, Venice! Everything you got, right now!
Final round! When I say flight, you say night! Flight!
Behind on the cards. Only big waves get you back now!
Kid needs big numbers! Save the safe stuff for the taco line!
Trailing, Venice! Get loud, this comeback needs a crowd!
Out front going into the final round. Close the door, kid!
You're leading! Finish strong and the sunset's yours!
Sunset guaranteed, Venice certified! The kid just took Flight Night!
Champion of the sand! Somebody get this dunker a trophy and a taco!
Tide came in and it never went out! You own Flight Night, my friend!
Venice, crown your winner! Pier to the parking lot, everybody up!
Tip your cap to the rival! Flight Night goes their way. Come get it back!
Not your night, kid. But the boardwalk remembers every dunk, and so do I.
Venice, love to both sides! Trophy goes to the rival, but the rematch is already booked!
Rival's night, not ours. Save the ticket stub, kid, the sequel's coming!
Splits on the baseline! Stretch it out, Venice!
Calling it early? Venice, you buying it?!
Hear that roar? The pier just shook!
Too small? Talking about the rim, right? Right!
Arms up! Venice, get yours up too!
Hand it over! Next dunker's up!
Controller swap! New dunker, same sand!
Player one, grab the controller! You're up!
Your turn, player two! Show Venice something!
We got a winner! Venice, crown the champ!
Player one takes the Dunk Duel! Bragging rights, all week!
Dunk Duel goes to player two! Couch champion of Venice!
All square! Nobody blinked. Run it back, both of you!
Tied up on the sand! The judges can't split you!
Welcome to Downtown on the beach! Five racks, sixty seconds, money balls on every rack. Six shooters, top three move on!
Downtown at Venice Beach! Sixty seconds, five racks, gold money balls worth two. Six shooters, only three advance!
Shooters on the sand! It's Downtown: five racks, sixty seconds, six shooters, top three advance. Grab that money ball!
Paddle out, shooter!
Sixty seconds, go!
Start splashing!
Next rack, keep rolling!
New rack, same sand!
Slide on over!
Roll to the next rack!
Last rack! Empty the tank!
Final rack, Venice, get loud!
One rack left, sunset's coming!
Money ball! Cash it!
Gold ball, double points!
Here's the money!
Payday on the beach!
Splash!
Count it!
Wet sand!
Boardwalk bucket!
Pure!
Swish, Venice!
Money in the bank!
Cash register's ringing!
Gold ball, gone!
Two-for-one special!
Short!
Choppy water!
Missed the wave!
Wipeout!
Next ball!
Surf's building, Venice!
Wave after wave!
Piling them up!
Rhythm on the boardwalk!
Automatic! Venice, stand up!
Every shot's a splash! Unreal!
Hotter than noon on the sand!
Pier's shaking! Nothing's missing!
Rim's closed for lunch, apparently!
Cold water! Shake it off!
Find the wave again, shooter!
Ten seconds! Quick hands!
Clock says ten! Hurry!
Final ten, empty the rack!
Beat the horn! It counts!
Out in time! Splash counts!
Just under the wire! Count it!
Numbers rolling in, one shooter at a time...
Let's check the board. Venice, hold your breath!
You're through to the final! Grab some water, shooter, you earned it!
Made the cut! The final's waiting, and Venice wants more!
Advancing! Save some splash for the final!
Out in qualifying. The waves just weren't breaking today. Come back soon!
So close, shooter! Grab a lemonade, and run it back!
Missed the cut, but Venice saw the touch. Next time, it falls!
Final round! You shoot last. Drum circle, give this shooter a beat!
Everybody else has posted. Last shooter on the sand, this one's yours to take!
The number's up on the board, kid. Top it, and the whole pier knows!
Number's cooked! Beach party!
Passed it! Downtown is yours!
Clinched! Pop the lemonade!
Three-point champion of Venice Beach! Splash after splash, and the ocean's jealous!
Downtown belongs to the kid! Boardwalk approved, trophy approved, taco on me!
Crown the shooter, Venice! Best touch on the beach, no argument!
Ones at Venice Beach! First to eleven, make it take it. One ball, two hoopers, the whole boardwalk watching!
Straight up, one on one! First to eleven, make it take it. Venice, get loud!
Threes at Venice Beach! Three on three, first to twenty-one, ninety seconds on the clock. Let's run!
Six hoopers, one court, ninety seconds! First to twenty-one takes the sand. Drum circle, go!
Their ball. Lock in, defense!
Check it up! Get a stop!
Defense, kid! Guard the boardwalk!
Ball's checked. Nothing easy, Venice!
Wet jumper!
Pull-up, cash!
Boardwalk approved!
Jumper's pure!
Buckets on the beach!
Sweet shot, sneakers!
Deep water! Splash!
Three from the pier!
Out past the lifeguard tower!
Cash, times three!
Rainbow over the ocean!
Soft off the glass!
Laid it in easy!
Sneaky finish!
Gentle as a wave!
Flushed it!
Rim's rattling!
Surf's up at the rim!
Sand flew on that one!
Ooh, jam session!
Postcard! Wish you were here!
Put it on the pier wall!
Posterized! Tourists, buy the print!
Over the top! Ocean's roaring!
Stop the boardwalk! Stop everything!
Whoa! Whole beach felt that one!
And one, Venice!
Through the contact! Count it!
Plus the freebie!
Bucket and a bonus!
Rimmed out.
Just off!
Rough surf, kid.
Close, no taco.
Airball! Straight into the ocean!
Ball's headed to the pier!
Beach ball, Venice!
Tourists, that's a souvenir!
Stamped and sent back!
Not on my boardwalk!
Swatted into the sand!
Blocked! Closed for business!
Pier security, denied!
Shut the gate!
Ooh, stuffed at the rim!
Denied at the door!
They saw that coming!
Wall went up! Regroup, kid!
Snatched it! Gone!
Picked clean!
Swiped! Off to the races!
Takeaway! Let's go!
Too quick, tide's turning!
Picked off! Get back!
Ooh, lost it!
Seagull got your fries!
Turnover! Shake it off!
Sneakers with the handle!
Ankle check on the boardwalk!
Wrong way, defender!
Crossed up! Wave goodbye!
Shook! Lifeguard, we need you!
Left them in the sand!
Bit on the bait!
Hook, line, and sinker!
Defender's still up there!
Sold it! Bought it!
Whistle! Everybody freeze!
Foul on the play!
Lifeguard's whistle! Stop the play!
Whoa, whoa! Hold the drums!
They splashed back! Lock in!
Their bucket. Next wave is ours!
Ooh, they got one. Next!
Tide goes both ways, Venice!
Shake it off, get it back!
Ooh, they threw one down!
Rival rocked the rim! Answer back!
That one shook the pier!
Big flush from the other side!
Big swell rolling in! Nobody's stopping it!
Run on the boardwalk! Venice, you seeing this?
Bucket, bucket, bucket! Somebody call a timeout!
Unanswered! Other side's stuck in beach traffic!
Game point, Venice! One more bucket, stand up!
Their game point! Venice, get loud for defense!
Game over! Winner stays on, Venice!
That's the run! Venice, give it up for the winner!
Ballgame! The sand is yours, the sunset too!
Winner! Tide came all the way in!
They take the run. Next time, the sand's yours.
Not today, kid. Grab next and run it back!
Rough tide. Respect the win, then come get yours!
Even at the buzzer! Nobody takes the sand!
All square when the horn sounds! Split the tacos!
Dime on the beach!
Great find! Beach-style sharing!
Unselfish! Love to see it!
Served it up hot!
Up top and in!
Alley-oop off the boardwalk!
High toss, big catch!
Ten seconds! Make it count!
Everybody up! Ten seconds!
Clock's almost gone! Ten left!
Overdrive! Full tide, full speed!
Meter's maxed! Here comes the wave!
Synergy's full! Ride it together!
Welcome to Game Night! Four events, points on every one, and one champion walks off the boardwalk!
Game Night, Venice! Four mini-events tonight, points for each, and only one champion. Step right up!
Carnival's in town! Four games, points on each, one champion. Boardwalk's calling it all!
Slam Rush! Twenty seconds, as many dunks as you can. Rim's open!
Next up, Strike Storm! Tag those pads, fast and clean!
Trick Gauntlet! Grab a deck, Dogtown style, and string those tricks!
Hot Shot time! Shots on goal, aim for the corners!
Coin Storm! Coins everywhere, grab every one before the tide does!
Counter round! Wait on the jab, then answer back quick!
Game on!
Let's ride!
Clock's live, go!
Five seconds! Everything now!
Last five, Venice, go!
Clock's almost out! Hurry!
Event goes to the kid! Points on the board!
Bank it! That one's yours, sneakers!
Won it! The carnival crowd is loving you!
Winner at the booth! Pick your prize, kid!
Rival grabs that one. Stay loose, kid!
Other side cashes in that one. Points go their way.
Missed that prize! Rival gets the big stuffed bear!
Tied up! Split the prize, Venice!
Neither side budged! Rematch at the ring toss!
Player two, step right up! Your booth now!
Pass it over! Player two, you're up!
Game Night champion! Win the prize, keep the prize, ride the Ferris wheel free!
Champion of the carnival! Biggest prize on the boardwalk, and it's yours!
Ring the carnival bell! Game Night belongs to you, Boardwalk approved!
Rival takes Game Night. Grab a churro, catch your breath, and we go again!
Game Night goes to the rival. Next carnival, we're coming for that prize!
